data.one_liner: Native MapLibre maps for Android, iOS and Web with vector tiles, PMTiles, GeoJSON and offline support
data.what_it_does: Provides a MapLibreMap widget that renders interactive vector maps using the MapLibre native engines on mobile and MapLibre GL JS on the web. It supports custom styles, annotations, clustering, heatmaps, and feature state. Offline regions are available on mobile only.
use_when: You need a vendor‑neutral map that works on Android, iOS and Web without API keys
You want to host your own tiles or mix providers
You need advanced vector tile features like clustering, heatmaps or feature state
avoid_when: You target desktop platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux)
You need Flutter widgets inside the map layers
You require offline support on the web
strengths: Full platform parity across Android, iOS and Web
Open source, no API key required
Supports PMTiles, GeoJSON, clustering, heatmaps and feature state
Built on MapLibre native engines for high performance
weaknesses: Map widgets cannot be placed inside the map layers
Requires native setup and permissions for location
data.setup_notes: Add package, set minimum Flutter/Dart versions, configure Android API 24+, iOS 15.5+, enable Swift Package Manager for iOS, add location permissions on Android/iOS, no index.html changes for web
